title: Void
summary: Void was the first Nullifier in ancient to history to arrive on Earth and was responsible for the creation of the Spiral Mark. Although originally thought by some Seekers to be a Titan himself, Void is in fact a Nullifier, contained in a unique Amulet, a blue crystal shard with an evil, red aura. While Void would be considered to be colossal when compared to the Titans, he is merely a small scout of the Nullifiers.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Long before recorded time, Void, a single Nullifier scout, found Earth by chance and created the Spiral Mark to act as a beacon to the rest of the Nullifiers, calling his brethren to Earth. [Words from Eathon] They were opposed by Lord Casterwill, the first Seeker, who summoned the Titans to Earth to fight a war against this threat. After a fierce 500-year conflict, Void and the Nullifiers were finally defeated and the Spiral Mark was sealed with a powerful spell so that no evil Seekers could ever gain use of it. [The Spiral Mark] 

After the death of Lord Casterwill, however, his most trusted friend betrayed Casterwill and his family, and attempted to call the Nullifiers back to Earth by performing a dark ritual at the Spiral Mark on the longest night of the year with the Amulet of Void. Casterwill's sons and daughters rose up once again and defeated the Betrayer. [Chasing Void]

Void's name became lost in the annals of time until his Amulet was uncovered and taken into safekeeping by the Casterwill family. It was eventually stolen by the Organization and fell into the hands of Klaus who locked it in his vault at his library. [Chasing Void]

Upon being prompted by Eathon's Holotome and Lucas Casterwill's team, Lok Lambert and the rest of Dante Vale's team went after the Amulet of Void. After tricking Wilder into revealing its location [The Blood Spiral], Lok succeeded in recovering the Amulet, however disaster soon struck. A wave of dark energy went out from the Amulet, and the Blood Spiral Brotherhood arrived, with Shauna reclaiming the Amulet and the entire library being destroyed. [The Blood Spiral]

On the longest night of the year, as part of the ritual to activate the Spiral Mark, Void was summoned by Rassimov before the entire Blood Spiral, masking the whole Blood Spiral Base with fog and smoke. [Words from Eathon]

In an attempt to double cross the Betrayer, Rassimov invoked Void to stop the impact of the Red Comet. Void's presence immediately disturbed both Lilith the Queen and Powerbonded Caliban. After Rassimov revealed his plan to use the Necklace of Tutankhamun to control the Nullifiers, Void was last seen teleporting Rassimov into space to the Red Comet. However, as the Comet collided with the pair, the Necklace was disintegrated and Rassimov was killed in the process, although the status of Void remains unknown. [The Spiral Mark]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Whilst the true extent of Void's abilities are unknown, he was shown to be able to create portals through which he can teleport both himself and others to specific locations. He was also able to float through space with his Seeker, contained inside a magical force field. {{source|The Spiral Mark}}
